svg.title: FAVR motivation: defect understanding and report grouping
svg.desc: The original three-panel composition is retained. Panel (a) keeps its chicken-and-egg illustration and circular arrows while its wording connects defect descriptions with report grouping instead of the number K. Panels (b) and (c) depict initial attribution errors and FAVR refinement. All text and shapes are native editable SVG objects.

g.inkscape:label: panel 2 attribution errors
g.text: Initial clustering is a hypothesis, not the final answer
But the grouping may still contain errors

text.tspan: are placed in the same group.
